# Runtime Evidence Delta

The Awtsmoos renews the reader beneath every passing test and visible frame;
Awtsmoos.com accepts no false green when the living browser reveals a different name.

## Measured browser evidence

The ten-contract Node/style reader universe passed, but CDP BrowserHarness exposed a real runtime rupture on the canonical local reader route.

Observed state after boot settled:

- `readerBootStarted = "true"`
- `readerBootCompleted = "true"`
- `socialReaderReady` absent
- `readerBootFailed` absent
- visible Typography remained inert
- `#realPost` rendered `SYSTEM RUPTURE: Illegal invocation`

Captured browser stack:

`NetzachGeometryGate.schedule` -> `scheduleGeometryCheck` -> `GevurahSidebarGate.setOpen` -> `toggleSidebar` -> `setupUIListeners` -> `prepareReaderBehavior` -> `ignite` -> `performReaderBoot`.

## Proven root cause

`GeometryGate.js` stores `globalThis.requestAnimationFrame` as a detached function and later invokes it as a method of the geometry gate. Browser-native animation scheduling requires the Window receiver, producing `TypeError: Illegal invocation`.

## Secondary contract failure

`ignite()` catches all bootstrap errors, writes a fatal placeholder, logs the rupture, and then returns normally. `postLogic.js` therefore marks boot completed even though the canonical reader never becomes ready.

## UX consequence

Visible shell controls depend on `setupUIListeners()`, which currently runs after initial data and identity hydration. The interface can therefore display controls before their interaction layer exists.
